title: Design violation: enum used in wolfssl_sha.c
description: src/providers/wolfssl/wolfssl_sha.c lines 28-33 define 'enum wolfssl_sha_type { WOLFSSL_SHA256=0, WOLFSSL_SHA384, WOLFSSL_SHA512, WOLFSSL_SHA3_256 }'. CLAUDE.md design constraint states: 'Any patch that adds a typedef enum, an anonymous enum... to any header or source file in this repo will be rejected at review, regardless of how convenient it seems.' The sha variant is internal-only (not UAPI), but the no-enum rule applies to all source files. Replace with #define integer constants, which are explicitly permitted for small permanently-closed sets (the rule notes: 'Current examples: op direction (encrypt/decrypt), fd type, key type, FIPS state').
